meta.title: Miel, coffee & brunch
meta.description: Specialty coffee and homemade brunch in the heart of Mons. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 8am to 5pm.

home.heroText: Specialty coffee and homemade brunch, from morning until 5pm. Come hungry, come whenever.
home.bandText: No booking needed: sit down for brunch, or grab your coffee on the way. Made to order, served with a smile.

favorites.name: Iced Honey Latte
favorites.text: espresso, cold silky milk, wildflower honey and honeycomb.

favorites.name: The Morning Toast
favorites.text: seeded bread, smashed avocado, poached egg and microgreens.

favorites.name: Blue Stack
favorites.text: fluffy pancakes, fresh blueberries, lemon and golden syrup.

favorites.name: The Golden Swirl
favorites.text: warm cinnamon-swirl brioche with honey glaze.

info.conceptText: Miel is the idea that mornings deserve better than a rush. Good coffee, homemade brunch, and no one hurrying you.
info.addressText: At the end of Rue de la Clef, five minutes from the Grand-Place. Come in, sit wherever you like, we'll take care of the rest.
info.storyText: A coffee and brunch house in the heart of Mons. Big windows, one long table and pancakes until close.
